title: Tandem workspace onboarding
audience: A new team administrator configuring a project collaboration workspace
scenario: Tandem needs a static onboarding screen showing the third step in a four-step setup flow.
task: Build the invite-your-team step with clear progress, role explanations, validation guidance, and safe secondary actions.

sections: Four-step progress indicator: Workspace, Preferences, Invite team, and Finish
Introductory copy explaining that invitations can also be sent later
Three email rows with role selections for Admin, Member, and Viewer
Role explanation for Admin, Member, and Viewer permissions
Back, Skip for now, and Send invitations actions
Help link titled Learn about workspace roles

requirements: Mark Invite team as the current step in machine-readable semantics
Use explicit labels for every email and role field
Provide an inline example of invalid-email guidance without requiring interaction
Make Back, Skip for now, and Send invitations visually and semantically distinguishable by intent
Preserve logical focus and reading order at narrow widths
constraints: Do not implement submission, row addition, navigation, or validation behavior
Do not prefill real personal information
Do not make Skip for now look destructive
Do not use remote assets, fonts, or APIs
evaluation_focus: Form semantics and explanation of roles
Honest static validation and control states
